pages.text: The Codex tracks your progress in real time, but $(note)the book can't print live numbers$(). Three commands report them in chat at any time:$(br)$(li)$(bold)/icraft codex balance$(): your token pool.$(li)$(bold)/icraft codex bosses$(): your boss-rush clears.$(li)$(bold)/icraft codex submit$(): bank materials into tokens.

pages.title: Your Token Balance
pages.text: $(bold)/icraft codex balance$()$(br2)Lists the tokens you hold against each tier's threshold ($(t2){{tier 1 threshold}}$() / $(t3){{tier 2 threshold}}$() / $(t4){{tier 3 threshold}}$()) and the tier your bulk metals currently mint toward. When a pool reaches its threshold, the Codex spends it and grants the next tier automatically.$(br2)Full table: $(l:icraft:progression/tier_unlock_checklist)Targets & Boss Rush$(/l).

pages.title: The Boss Rush
pages.text: $(bold)/icraft codex bosses$()$(br2)Shows how many of each tier's bosses you have cleared and the share you need: $(t2){{tier 1 rushpct}}$() / $(t3){{tier 2 rushpct}}$() / $(t4){{tier 3 rushpct}}$(). Clear that share and you advance automatically, with no tokens needed.$(br2)Every boss and miniboss kill also feeds the token pool, so the two routes stack.

pages.title: Banking Materials
pages.text: $(bold)/icraft codex submit$() turns the eligible materials you carry into tokens, capped per material and lossless.$(br)$(li)$(bold)submit engineering$(): Create, Thermal and Mekanism metals and machines.$(li)$(bold)submit magic$(): Botania, Ars and Occultism reagents and apparatus.

pages.title: Banking Materials, cont.
pages.text: The $(bold)Submit$() button in the Engineering and Magic Crafting quest groups does the same cap-safe banking in one click.$(br2)Exploration and Combat need no submit: they mint as you play.
